t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The colour and gnomes don't really mean anything, the 1x was for gnomes on the left hand side and the right for 5x. These swapped and 0 meant 0 regardless

vb_textbox.text: I don't think there was any basis on the gnome colour or type, it's purely random, I then picked one side for 1x and 1 side for 5x and rotated each quarter. If its a 0 then it will be a 0 regardless of what gnome you pick.
